note: The original (Holmgren 1913, the Ceylonitermes subgenus section) writes Imago unbekannt, so no alate section is given. The text is a Fraktur OCR with many corrupt readings (e.g. Kopf ziemlieh langgestreekt eiförmig, eingesehnürt); anything that cannot be read with certainty is not quoted. The original description also contains body colour and measurements, which fall outside the quotation limit of this entry.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier nasus 2/3 of head length, very narrow, cylindrical and straight; antennae long, 12 segments. Worker clypeus large and inflated, its length half its width; the first two mandibular teeth equal in size; antennae 15 segments.
